pairs.subject: agent-cli-transport
pairs.evidence: src/features/browser/twinDraftLane.ts:252 The Twin toolbar types whatever twin_draft_for_page returns straight into the third-party page box. That command never consults the result envelope's is_error/subtype and falls back to raw stdout as the answer, and a non-zero exit is one opaque string without stderr, so usage-limit, logged-out and crash all reach the lane (twinDraftLane.ts:277) as the same failure.

techniques.evidence: src-tauri/src/commands/infrastructure/twin.rs:2049 The last rung returns raw stdout as the answer, the result event's error flag is ignored, and llm.rs:208 flattens non-zero exits to 'Claude CLI returned non-zero exit code' with stderr not captured.

src-tauri/src/engine/twin_setup/llm.rs:61 LEAN_ARGS passes --tools "" --strict-mcp-config --disable-slash-commands, so the page-draft child over page content truly has no tools despite the bypass flag.
